description: Use this when the user wants to find public daylily cultivar reference records by name, hybridizer, color, parentage, or general search text. Do not use it to answer questions about a signed-in user's own inventory; use daylily.list_listings for that. Prefer specific fields over q when the user asks for a known facet.

q.description: Broad public cultivar search text. Prefer field-specific filters when the user asks for a specific facet.

name: daylily.search_cultivars
title: Search Cultivars
